title: 验证卷 #11 · been 的两条路 + 时态标志词收尾
topic: IELTS 城市 / 健康话题
goal: 本次验证三个漏洞：① been 的用法（被动 has been done / 状态 has been + 形容词）② ago 反向确认一般过去时 ③ 不规则动词过去分词

questions.prompt: The cycling lanes in the city centre ____ (widen) twice since 2021.
questions.explanation: since 2021 → 现在完成时；lanes 复数 → have；车道是被市政拓宽的（自己不会拓宽）→ 被动语态 have been widened。注意 been 在这里是 be 的过去分词，帮助构成「被动态的完成时」。

questions.prompt: The lecture hall ____ (be) empty since the university moved to online classes.
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点 → 现在完成时；主语 lecture hall 单数 → has。这里 be 是系动词，has been + empty 表示「一直处于空着的状态」——been 是 be 的过去分词，它自己不带动作，只负责状态。

questions.prompt: Construction of the new stadium ____ (finish) in 2024, and it has been in use ever since.
questions.explanation: in 2024 是已经结束的过去时间点 → 第一空用一般过去时 finished；后半句的 ever since 才配现在完成时（has been in use）。两个时间标志词各管各的句子：in 2024 管第一空，ever since 管第二空。

questions.prompt: Volunteers ____ (bring) warm clothes to the shelter every winter since 2019.
questions.explanation: since 2019 → 现在完成时；Volunteers 复数 → have。bring 是不规则动词，过去分词是 brought（bring-brought-brought），不是 bringed。
